overall_summary: The channel shows low overall view counts across all videos, indicating early-stage performance or limited distribution. However, content focused on 'self respect' with actionable, micro-moment hooks (like deleting chats, changing statuses, or managing phone notifications) performs relatively better compared to broad emotional topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views) and 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर' (41 views) perform better than abstract emotional concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on concrete, highly relatable digital micro-actions (e.g., clearing notifications, hiding statuses, removing pinned chats).

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing purely on passive waiting or generic late-night thoughts (e.g., 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' with 6 views) underperform.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive descriptions; always anchor the emotion to an active, physical, or digital realization.
